scripts.build:native: napi build --platform --esm --output-dir generated --js native-binding.js --dts native-binding.d.ts --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml
scripts.build:release: napi build --platform --esm --release --output-dir generated --js native-binding.js --dts native-binding.d.ts --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml && tsc -p tsconfig.json
